title: Hikers rescued after using Google Gemini for planning
summary: The sheriff’s office said the hikers “were advised by Gemini to bring far less food and water than their group required."
llm_summary: A group of hikers who relied on Google’s Gemini AI to plan their trek ended up stranded and had to be rescued after the system recommended they pack far less food and water than the journey actually required. The sheriff’s office highlighted the miscalculation, noting that Gemini’s advice left the party under‑prepared
